entities.name: Guaraní and Littoral Peoples
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Guaraní inhabited the Mesopotamian region (Entre Ríos, Corrientes, Misiones) with sophisticated slash-and-burn agriculture, producing manioc, maize, and yerba mate. Alongside them, Chaná, Timbú, and other peoples occupied the Paraná River littoral with fishing-based economies.
